title: Machine learning and DFT discover high-entropy Invar alloys
summary: A closed-loop active-learning framework combining machine learning, density-functional theory and thermodynamic calculations screened millions of compositions. Of 17 new alloys processed and characterized, two high-entropy Invar alloys showed very low thermal expansion, about 2 x 10^-6 per kelvin at 300 K. Only the top-ranked candidates were synthesized, so the hit rate is small.
ai_technology: Closed-loop active learning combining machine learning, density-functional theory and thermodynamic calculations
organization: Max Planck Institute for Iron Research; Delft University of Technology

evidence.tested: 17 new alloys were processed and characterized; two high-entropy Invar alloys showed very low thermal expansion of about 2 x 10^-6 per kelvin at 300 K.
evidence.unknown: The method works on very sparse data, and the abstract notes that thermodynamic design rules alone often fail in high-dimensional spaces; no further limits are stated.
